description.value: Big Chicken Town is a Korean fried chicken restaurant in Surrey, BC, specializing in double-fried chicken with traditional Korean recipes and signature sauces such as Honey Garlic, Black Yummy, and Green Mountain. The menu also includes Korean classics like spicy rice cakes. Online ordering is available for pickup or delivery, and the restaurant has its own mobile app.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website clearly places Big Chicken Town at 15280 101 Ave #130 Surrey, BC V3R 8X7 with phone (604) 496-5007, contradicting the OSM community tag of 'North Vancouver' — though the OSM coordinates (49.185N, 122.799W) do fall within Surrey. The website confirms online ordering for pickup or delivery, establishing takeout as true. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
